sloka: अगृह्य यदि गच्छामि विशल्यकरणीमहम् ।कालात्ययेन दोषः स्याद्वैक्लव्यं च महद्भवेत् ।। ६.१०२.२७ ।।
transliteration: agṛhya yadi gacchāmi viśalyakaraṇīmaham ।kālātyayena doṣaḥ syādvaiklavyaṁ ca mahadbhavet ।। 6.102.27 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle Hanumantha! Going to that mountain of herbs about which Jambavan had earlier spoken to you, get the herbs from the southern peak of that great mountain. To make Lakshmana the great soul alive quickly go and get Savarankarani, Sarvakarani so also Sanjeevakarani and Sandhanakarani and come."
